tables.name: Garrison Size
tables.description: How many guards defend the fortress. Large and Maximum add Guard Bunks to the keep's starting rooms.

results.name: Minimum
results.description: The garrison is the smallest necessary to do the job, so is likely overworked, or unable to handle more than absolutely vital tasks. A force this size requires few commanding officers.

results.name: Modest
results.description: The garrison’s size is large enough to sufficiently defend the fortress and allow for reasonable guard shifts.

results.name: Large
results.description: The garrison’s size is substantial, and is more than enough to keep the fortress well-defended at all times. Guards are able to stay well-rested. (When building a keep, add ‘Guard Bunks’ to the listed starting rooms)

results.name: Maximum
results.description: The garrison’s size is the highest the fortress can sustain. (When building a keep, add ‘Guard Bunks’ to the listed starting rooms)
